usedFor: Copper holds leads, and TURKEY SMS texts them when “New Lead” runs “Send SMS”, sent through your TURKEY SMS account.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Copper, then “Send SMS” in TURKEY SMS
bestTemplate.why: It does the most real work: a fresh lead in Copper gets a first text to the number you set.

watchOut: “Send SMS” texts a specified phone number, so a “New Lead” saved without one has nothing to send to.
